remarks: Welcome to this bright, spacious 3-bedroom flat filled w/natural light & sweeping views of LI Sound, sky, trees & city. In an elegant hi rise w/luxe amenities that incl 24/7 front door concierge security, htd pool, 2-gyms & library - this unit has 2-deeded garage spots. The apartment features wonderfully open design for easy living & entertaining w/superb views, rooms bathed in sunshine, custom built-ins PLUS in-unit washer & dryer, individual heating & cooling in each rm, 2-yr old water heater & excellent storage. Large open LR and DR w/wall of floor-to-ceiling glass capture the beauty of the dramatic setting & they are open to the well-equipped Kitchen - perfect layout for today's style of living. Kitchen has wood countertops, abundant cabinetry, young appliances including 2-yr old refrigerator, and open breakfast bar. All 3-rooms share the stunning window wall views! Privately set Primary suite has roomy BR, lg w/walk-in closet, 2nd closet, built-ins, marble ensuite bathroom, & panoramic double aspect views. There are 2 add'l light-filled BRs - one currently used as a den has a wall of built-in bookshelves & storage, and there's a full marble hall bathroom. Laundry, linen, storage & utility closets provide finishing touches, and there's an assigned bldg storage unit, too! PLUS all assessments paid in full. Walk to shops, restaurants, theater & you're on a bus line to Metro North. Exceptional space, views, location & amenities in a luxe setting can be yours!
